title: Professor Alice Roberts: From Cell to Civilisation - Live on Stage
description:
Who are we? Where do we come from? What does it mean to be human?

For thousands of years, such questions have been explored through philosophy and religion, but the answers now seem to lie firmly within the grasp of an empirical approach to the world and our place within it. By peering deep into our past and dragging clues out into the light, science can now provide us with some of the answers to the questions that people have always asked. From the first spark of life on earth 3.8 billion years ago, we track the evolution and connectivity of all living things.

Join us as we follow in the footsteps of our ancestors from Africa into Asia and around the Indian coastline, to Australia, north into Europe and Siberia, and, eventually, to the last continents to be peopled: the Americas. We’ll meet some other human species along the way.

We’ll examine the sophistication of some of the earliest civilisations, and we’ll discuss how we know what we know and why we think what we think, what the science can tell us.
This is the story of us, from single cell to civilisation.

title: John Simpson: The Leaders & Lunatics Tour
description:
After successive sell-out tours, legendary journalist and broadcaster John Simpson CBE returns to the stage with a bold, unflinching look at leadership: why some inspire while others descend into tyranny.

With nearly 60 years of unparalleled access to world leaders—and lunatics—John will explore the personalities that have shaped history. From notorious figures including Putin, Assad, Saddam, Gaddafi and Trump to admired leaders such as Gorbachev, Mandela, Havel, and Zelensky, he'll reveal their common threads, unique quirks, and lasting impact.

What makes a tyrant? Are they mad, or more calculating than we'd like to believe? Will Trump's deal-making bring peace, or give dictators room to manoeuvre? And in a world of wars and climate catastrophe, who's actually leading?

In the second half, the floor is yours. From the fall of the Berlin Wall to the collapse of the Soviet Union, from the Iranian Revolution to the Gulf Wars and Tiananmen Square, John has been there.

This evening examines how sane societies slip into despotism, and how this can happen with unexpected ease. Ask your questions as John offers insights into past and present events, an enlightening evening for our troubled times.

title: Scott Matthews: Passing Stranger 20th Anniversary Tour
description:
Twenty years ago, Scott Matthews emerged from the Black Country, challenged the status quo and quickly established himself as one of the most revered singer-songwriters of a generation with his mesmeric and inimitable debut album, Passing Stranger. The album that fearlessly pushed generic boundaries with a unique tapestry of folk, rock, blues and ethnic song-writing, earned Matthews some of the highest accolades in the music industry.

It was 2006 when BBC Radio 1’s Zane Lowe first held his audience in breathless suspense when he aired Matthews’ debut single, Elusive, for the first time, instantly hailing the emerging artist as ‘an exceptional God’s gift’. This was the catalyst that gained the respect of many fellow artists, prompting tours with Robert Plant, Snow Patrol, Bert Jansch, Foo Fighters, Rufus Wainwright and Tori Amos.

To celebrate the milestone anniversary, a rare and unforgettable opportunity to see Scott Matthews accompanied by a band full of musicality and colour, will perform Passing Stranger live in its entirety. Describing what live performance means to him, Matthews says, ‘The lifeblood of these songs flow at their purest and headiest when connecting with a live audience. In all my adventures on the road, I feel most alive when the barriers are knocked down, exposed and leaving nothing behind.’

It is clear Matthews has left an indelible mark upon the world of music. Through his poetic lyricism, soaring vocals and intricate guitar playing, he weaves a magic that entrances audiences. It is no wonder that his shows have become globally renowned for their spiritual atmosphere, transcending the restraints of time… this is a show not to be missed.

A celebration of Beethoven at his romantic and dramatic best.

Beethoven is not known as a man of the theatre, with only one opera (Fidelio) under his belt, and he struggled mightily with it. Leonora is one of the many overtures Beethoven tried out for Fidelio, and this particular version distils the opera’s powerful plot into an intense fifteen minutes. Yet Beethoven also wrote some brilliantly dramatic orchestral overtures for theatrical productions, including the tragic Coriolan, and the spirited, ultimately triumphant Egmont. His Violin Concerto, meanwhile, is one of the most beautiful and quietly revolutionary pieces he ever composed. The multi-talented Eugene Tzikindelean conducts and takes the solo part in one of Beethoven’s best-loved works.

A thoroughly swinging time is guaranteed: jazz, ballet – and a funky fusion of both.

‘You really know it’s Christmas when The Nutcracker makes its appearance’. So wrote American dance critic Marcia B. Siegel: and she’s not wrong. With its magical toys and journey to the Land of Sweets, Tchaikovsky’s ballet could hardly be more Christmassy. This sparkling concert features a festive selection from The Nutcracker alongside Duke Ellington’s very individual take on the piece. From ‘Toot-toot-tootie-toot’ to ‘Sugar Rum Cherry’, Ellington jazzes up Tchaikovsky in style. In between, Bernstein’s Prelude, Fugue and Riffs will have you grooving with its sassy swagger. The CBSO’s own Oliver Janes takes the solo clarinet part, which was originally written for jazz supremo Benny Goodman.

Qawwali World presents The Legacy of Qawwali featuring the mesmerising Chand Ali Khan – the UK’s leading Qawwali Artist honouring 30 years since the passing of the legendary Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan – celebrating the extraordinary musical legacy of the man whose voice took Qawwali from the mehfils of South Asia to audiences across the world.

For generations, Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan’s Qawwalis have touched hearts, transcended borders and become timeless classics. His unparalleled voice, spiritual intensity and ability to connect deeply with audiences continue to inspire musicians and listeners around the globe.

This special show is a celebration of that enduring legacy, featuring Chand Ali Khan and ensemble in a powerful live tribute dedicated to the best and breadth of Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan’s most popular, beloved and unforgettable Qawwalis.

This captivating night explores spellbinding Qawwali and Sufiana melodies guided by the unparalleled artistry of Chand Ali Khan – the UK’s leading virtuoso in the sacred art form of Qawwali, and disciple of the legendary Ustad Rahat Fateh Ali Khan, nephew of Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan.

Deeply influenced by the Qawwali greats, Chand Ali Khan has reached international acclaim for taking the UK by storm with his unique portrayal and interpretation of soulful Qawwalis. With his mesmerising vocal repertoire, dynamic rhythms and entrancing harmonies of his exceptionally skilled musicians, Chand Ali Khan and his ensemble will take you on a journey of spiritual connection, catharsis and complete exhilaration.

30 years on, join us as we gather to celebrate the voice, the music and the legacy of the greatest Qawwal to have ever lived.

title: The Ukulele Orchestra of Great Britain: 40th Anniversary Concert
description:
2025 marked the 40th anniversary of The Ukulele Orchestra of Great Britain, who, from their humble beginnings in small rooms above old pubs, took the world by storm with their off-beat humour and four-stringed virtuosity.

Formed in 1985 as the antidote to the ego-driven bluster of the music industry, ‘The Ukes’ soon became the unlikely superheroes of the international touring circuit, spreading their irrepressible magic from Australasia to the North Pole, Windsor Castle to Carnegie Hall.

Millions of plucks later, they are still thrilling audiences with their all-singing, all-strumming, full throttle, foot-stomping concerts. There are no drums, pianos, backing tracks, guitars, or banjos, no pitch shifters or electronic trickery - just the astonishing revelation afforded by the rich orchestration of differently tuned ukuleles and dynamic vocals. This is an orchestra like no other. These are the sultans of ping!

Buckle up for a helter-skelter ride through every kind of musical genre with plenty of laughs along the way. There is something for everyone in this unique programme of Classical, Pop, Punk, Funk, Disco, Bluegrass and Metal.

Nobody does it quite like The Ukes.

Featuring musicians who have performed and recorded alongside Morrison himself, join the band as they play all ten tracks in their original running order - along with the songs that Van Morrison recorded for the album, but held back, only to become hits several years later. Witness The Van Morrison Alumni Band capture the passion and spontaneity that made the album legendary, as Leo Green delves into the making of Moondance through some extraordinary stories.

Then enjoy a second half packed with Van Morrison's most loved hits, as Leo shares insight into the songs, along with first-hand recollections of times on the road and in the studio with one of the greatest songwriters of our time. More than an album tribute, this is an incredible journey inside the music, told and performed by musicians who know Van Morrison's world from the inside.

For more than two decades, Rodrigo y Gabriela have pushed acoustic guitar into new territory, blending classical, rock, metal, cinematic atmosphere, and spiritual exploration into a sound entirely their own.

“This return to basic principles appears to have reignited their belief in creating edge-of-the-seat drama by letting two acoustic guitars play off each other... The essence of Rodrigo y Gabriela remains intact after a quarter of a century.” MOJO – 4 stars ****

title: Miloš
description:
MILOŠ is one of the world’s most celebrated classical guitarists. His career began its meteoric rise in 2011, with the release of his international best-selling Deutsche Grammophon debut album ‘Mediterraneo’. Since then, he has earned legions of fans, awards, and acclaim around the world through his extensive touring, six chart topping recordings and television appearances.

His latest album, simply entitled ‘Baroque’ featured a carefully curated selection of baroque works especially transcribed and arranged for the guitar, both solo and in collaboration with Jonathan Cohen and his ensemble Arcangelo.

Over the past decade, the instrument’s popularity has exploded thanks to MILOŠ’ pioneering approach. Aspiring guitarists can even learn from him through Schott’s ‘Play Guitar with Miloš’ series. In 2016 BBC Music Magazine included him in their list of ‘Six of the Best Classical Guitarists of the past century’.

MILOŠ has appeared as a soloist with some of the world’s greatest orchestras: London and LA Philharmonics, Atlanta Symphony, Philadelphia Orchestra, Chicago Symphony, Cleveland Orchestra, Orquesta Nacional de España, Santa Cecilia Rome and NHK Tokyo. The protagonists Jan Pascal and Alexander Kilian could hardly be more different in character, yet on stage they merge into a world-class unity. Their live performances are captivating dialogues that regularly bring audiences to their feet, described as 'audibly limitless' by Süddeutsche Zeitung. title: Frank Gardner: Out There
description:
Dangerous places. Wild adventures. One extraordinary life.


Frank Gardner is the BBC’s Security Correspondent. He has also kayaked among icebergs in Antarctica, met mountain gorillas in Rwanda, and filmed a raid on a Colombian jungle drug lab on his phone. And yes, in 2004 he was shot six times in Riyadh. It didn’t stop him for long. Frank’s message is simple: a catastrophic, life-changing injury doesn’t mean the fun stops.

In this one-man show, Frank tells the story in full. How he became the BBC’s first full-time Gulf correspondent, the day that changed everything, and what he found on the other side: “something oddly liberating about a near-death experience.” The determined, often funny road back. And the life since, the spy novels, remote places, and some very unlikely adventures, much of it told through his own footage and photographs. Then the world as he sees it now. After decades reporting from the Middle East and beyond, he cuts through the headlines to what is really going on. The news moves fast, sometimes within the span of a single tour, so don’t expect every night to be quite the same. Finally, it’s your turn. In a live audience Q&A, ask Frank anything, from spy novels to the state of the world.

Funny, candid, eye-opening, and uplifting: this is the story only Frank Gardner could tell.

title: How Far Away Are They? An Evening with the Cast of Phoenix Nights
description:
Twenty-five years after Phoenix Nights first opened its doors, join members of the cast for an evening of stories, laughter and a look behind the scenes of one of Britain’s best-loved comedies. How Far Away Are They? brings together familiar faces from the Phoenix Club to share their memories of making the series and creating its unforgettable characters at Birmingham's Town Hall. Featuring cast members Neil Fitzmaurice, Toby Foster, Steve Edge, Janice Connolly and Archie Kelly, with host Chelsey Ward, this is a chance to hear what happened when the cameras stopped rolling, how favourite moments came together, and what life has been like since. Expect affectionate recollections, backstage tales and plenty of laughs as the cast revisit the world of Brian Potter’s club, from its wonderfully questionable entertainment to the characters who made every visit memorable.

There’s also a full audience Q&A, giving you the opportunity to put your own questions to the people who were there. Whether you’ve wondered about a particular scene, or a favourite line, now’s your chance to ask.

The Manchester Arena live show has never been broadcast and isn’t available on streaming services. Hear about that remarkable reunion, revisit the original series and discover the stories behind both, directly from the cast themselves.

Come with your mates, bring your questions, and enjoy an evening celebrating a comedy that people are still quoting a quarter of a century later.

The album, and its singles Run, Lean on You and Spirit have received a rapturous response from her army of fans in the UK and US and The Artist Tour will celebrate the success of this spectacular album.


You can expect live performances of the album’s extraordinary songs, alongside the songs that made her name on Britain’s Got Talent and on her debut album My Way. And it wouldn’t be a Sydnie Christmas show without her wonderful storytelling and, of course, a few surprises!

title: William Hanson Presents: The Mannersphere
description:

William returns to the stage to reflect on the state of manners today and embarks on a mission to counter toxic masculinity and re-civilise the nation.


Part memoir, part variety show, part public service, The Mannersphere traces the making of an etiquette expert, beginning with a teenager inventing his own genre of murder mystery (camp crime) and ending, several home videos later, with a published novel called A Fatal Forking. Somewhere in between, William Hanson is made.


Expect laughs. Expect introspection. Expect cutlery.

Despite contrasting lifestyles and creative approaches, the pair’s remarkable chemistry remains at the heart of their music, creating performances that are warm, sincere and deeply moving. title: Kazuki Conducts Birmingham Contemporary Music Group
description:
A single sound can open into an entire world.

Kazuki Yamada conducts Birmingham Contemporary Music Group (BCMG) in a major concert at Birmingham Town Hall, culminating in the world premiere of Dai Fujikura’s new version of his Bassoon Concerto. Written for BCMG’s Nikolaj Henriques, the piece begins with the bassoon’s ability to produce several notes at once, then enlarges those complex sounds across the ensemble. Fujikura has described the surrounding instruments as an ‘aura’ radiating from the soloist.

The premiere reunites Fujikura, Yamada and BCMG following their acclaimed collaboration on the composer’s Shō Concerto, first performed in Birmingham before travelling to Tokyo. This new concerto has been created through BCMG’s Sound Investment scheme, supported directly by people who believe in bringing new music into the world.

Elsewhere, Jonathan Harvey’s solo clarinet searches a luminous summer sky in Cirrus Light. Misato Mochizuki places a veil between sound and perception in Voilages, while Fujikura’s Folksongs and an Anthem transforms familiar melodies through the colours of a contemporary ensemble.

Hear something entirely new take shape for the first time, under one of the world’s leading conductors.

Concerto for Bassoon and Ensemble has been commissioned with the support of the Sumitomo Life Welfare and Culture Foundation.

title: The Makings of a Murderer: Fatal Mistake
description:
with Donal MacIntyre

They planned the murder.
They covered their tracks.
They thought they had got away with it.

They almost did.

In The Makings of a Murderer: Fatal Mistake, award-winning investigative journalist and broadcaster Donal MacIntyre examines the extraordinary true stories of killers who came terrifyingly close to escaping justice.

These are the murderers who lied convincingly, destroyed evidence, created false alibis and, in some cases, remained free for years.

But somewhere, something went wrong.

A tiny forensic trace. A forgotten witness. A change in behaviour. A piece of CCTV. A phone call. A contradiction. One mistake that finally began to unravel everything.

Drawing on some of the most compelling murder investigations of modern times, Donal takes audiences inside the hunt for killers who believed they had committed the perfect crime.

How did they avoid suspicion for so long?
What finally gave them away?
And just how close did they really come to getting away with murder?

Gripping, revealing and packed with extraordinary real-life cases, The Makings of a Murderer: Fatal Mistake explores the killers who nearly beat the system - and the investigators, evidence and chance discoveries that finally brought them to justice.

title: Music of the Mystics: Sufi Qawwali Night with Fanna-Fi-Allah
description:
Fanna-Fi-Allah return to Birmingham Town Hall with Music of the Mystics, an evening of traditional Sufi qawwali.

Now in their 27th year of international touring, Fanna-Fi-Allah are one of the foremost traditional qawwali ensembles performing today. With thousands of concerts across more than fifty countries, they carry the living music of the Sufi shrines of Pakistan and India to audiences around the world. Led by Tahir Qawwal, with tabla, harmonium and a chorus of voices and clapping hands, the ensemble stays rooted in the classical form: no fusion, no electronics, no crossover.

A qawwali evening builds slowly. The poetry of Sufi saints such as Amir Khusrau and Baba Farid is sung in long, rising cycles that gather the whole room, and a whirling dervish turns as the music peaks. Though born in the Sufi Islamic tradition, this music welcomes everyone, whatever their background, into a shared space of unity and devotion.

title: Blancmange & xPropaganda
description:
Blancmange featuring Neil Arthur and Finlay Shakespeare and xPropaganda, featuring Claudia Brücken and Susanne Freytag, have announced plans for a joint UK tour, bringing together two bands whose music helped shape the electronic pop landscape of the 1980s.


Both acts emerged during a period of experimentation in British and European electronic music, developing distinctive sounds that continue to find an audience more than four decades later.


Blancmange, led by singer and songwriter Neil Arthur, first came to prominence in the early 1980s with singles including Living on the Ceiling, Waves, Blind Vision and Don't Tell Me. Their combination of synthesised rhythms, melodic songwriting and Arthur's distinctive vocals established them as a significant presence in the UK electronic music scene. Since returning to recording and performing, Blancmange have maintained a steady output of new material, exploring different approaches to electronic songwriting while retaining the character of their earlier work.


xPropaganda, featuring original vocalists Claudia Brücken and Susanne Freytag, emerged from Düsseldorf in the early 1980s and became closely associated with Trevor Horn's ZTT Records. Their 1985 album A Secret Wish brought together electronic arrangements, atmospheric production and the contrasting vocal styles of Brücken and Freytag. Tracks including Dr. Mabuse, Duel and P-Machinery remain among the band's best-known recordings.

Take the opportunity to see both acts on the same bill at Birmingham's Town Hall, each performing a set drawn from their respective catalogues and new material.

With Bolan's special ingredient of rock-a-boogie songs, the band had a string of huge hits throughout the 1970s including Get it On, Telegram Sam, Jeepster, and 20th Century Boy. This year T.Rextasy will be commemorating the tragic loss of this truly iconic glam rock Superstar in 1977.

T.Rextasy have now been performing around the world for over 20 years. The band is now accepted as the world’s only official live tribute band dedicated to Marc Bolan & T.Rex, and the only band endorsed and approved by Marc Bolan’s family, estate, original ex-members of T.Rex, and Bolan’s catalogue management. The band has been described by many as ‘beyond the boundaries of tribute’.

title: Sophie McCartney: Queenage Dirtbag
description:
Now in her 40s, Sophie McCartney has officially entered her ‘Queenage’ years. At this point in her life, she should be a responsible adult. A capable parent. A successful career woman with strong opinions on important issues.

Unfortunately, she didn't get the memo.


While the world is healing its inner child, Sophie's lost one of hers in Asda. Everyone else is cleansing their gut; she's burning hers with three spicy margaritas on a Wednesday. She's desperate to go further in life. Unfortunately, she forgot to charge the electric car. Again.


Following a barnstorming run of her critically acclaimed One Foot in the Rave tour, award-winning comedian and double Sunday Times No. 1 bestselling author Sophie McCartney is back with Queenage Dirtbag — a brand-new stand-up show tackling motherhood, millennial misbehaviour, double standards and the ever-widening gap between the woman she's supposed to be and the one she actually is.


Long live the Queenage Dirtbag.
